overview: This House resolution assigns six members of the House to standing committees, the permanent panels that review bills on particular subjects. It places members on the Homeland Security, Agriculture, Natural Resources, Transportation and Infrastructure, Oversight and Government Reform, and Foreign Affairs committees, and in two cases sets their seniority rank on the committee. Resolutions like this are routine and are used to fill open committee seats. The House approved it on March 25, 2026.
for: Supporters say filling open committee seats is a routine step that lets committees work at full strength.
against: Critics say it is internal housekeeping that changes no law or spending, so it has little direct effect on the public.
